research.title: minicollide: Numerical Methods for Real-Time Rigid-Body Dynamics in a Compact, Deterministic Physics Engine
research.summary: A from-scratch 3D rigid-body physics engine built as a laboratory for the numerical methods behind real-time simulation: symplectic integration, sweep-and-prune broadphase, SAT and GJK+EPA collision detection, and a warm-started sequential-impulse solver. Constraint islands are solved in parallel with bit-exact determinism, validated with four instrumented demos.
